skill_name: Suggest what someone should do if they need to de-stress.
workflow: There are many different activities that can help a person to de-stress, such as meditation, yoga, deep breathing, journaling, talking to a friend or family member, or even taking a hot bath. Exercise and changing up the scenery can also be beneficial. Taking a break to do something enjoyable, such as reading a book, watching a movie, or going for a walk can be a great way to help release tension and relax.
